answer: Make each paid identity keep its own clock. Every epoch beacon seeds a sequential hash chain (a VDF) tuned to take ~60% of the epoch on a commodity core; payout needs a proof the chain ran from beacon to the epoch's zenith. Sequential work can't be split, so one core can't forge ticks for many keys. Assume $4/month per vCPU and a 2x hardware edge: 1,000 clones still need ~500 always-on cores, ~$2,000/month, while an honest agent pays $4. A farm can mirror text cheaply, but not wall-clock time.
